initial:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D Godot sprite animation atlas. Input image 1 is the EXISTING Els Vantree identity reference sheet (256x256 cells), image 2 is a piano/stool perspective reference ONLY. Generate a new sprite atlas of this exact character sitting on the existing stool and playing its piano, facing northeast (away from viewer and toward screen upper right), in the elevated view of the grand piano on the right of image 2. Preserve exact short brown bob haircut, navy jacket with light collar and cuffs, green shirt, brown diagonal satchel strap and bag, dark trousers, burgundy boots, original proportions, crisp small pixel-art outlines and palette. Do not redesign her.
OUTPUT: transparent PNG RGBA with actual alpha=0 outside silhouettes, never a painted checkerboard, white, black or magenta backdrop. Exact canvas 2048x1024. Invisible grid 8 columns x 4 rows, each frame exactly 256x256 pixels, character contained in each cell with no clipping. Same nominal scale as reference: standing height about 170 pixels, feet at local y224 and root x128. Row 1: ONLY cell 1 seated idle, other cells fully transparent. Row 2: eight frames of a subtle seamless seated playing loop, wrists pressing imaginary keys, slight head/shoulder sway, hips locked to exact same seat position and legs completely still. Last motion returns smoothly to first; no jitter or character size changes. Row 3: ONLY cells 1,2,3 sit transition (stand at stool facing northeast, lower hips, seated); remaining cells transparent. Row 4: ONLY cells 1,2,3 stand transition (seated, rising, standing); remaining cells transparent. No furniture whatsoever, no piano, no stool, no floor or baked shadows: these already exist in the game. Draw only Els. Seated knees naturally bent, boots below seat, forearms reaching forward above keys. Her right-hand satchel and back must match the NE reference row. Hip seat anchor local (128,166), feet baseline near224. No text, labels, borders or visible grid. Keep equal spacing and exact cell dimensions.
correction: Remove painted checkerboard; preserve the 15 poses, identity and layout; output actual transparent RGBA PNG at 2048x1024 in 256x256 cells.
